title: KMtronic
body: Integrate [KMtronic devices](https://www.kmtronic.com/) into Home Assistant. KMtronic offers a large range of IP-connected relays that can be controlled over your local area network. This integration maps each of the relays as a separate device, enabling you to control various areas of your home (e.g. using each relay to control different garden sprinkler areas, or controlling the electrical distribution of your house from a central board).
